name: Witchwoven

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Familiar block (CR 1). Bond ritual: 10 minutes with materials worth 100+ gp (a ruby wrapped in a wicker cage); the Familiar Bond rules (bonded sympathy, channel magic, telepathic connection, 1-hour revival) are on page 580 and are listed once in the notes file.

actions.name: Cursed Scratch
actions.summary: +5, 1d6+3 Piercing plus 1d6 Necrotic; the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the witchwoven's next turn.

reactions.name: Protective Bond
reactions.trigger: A creature it sees within 60 ft takes damage.
reactions.summary: When a creature it can see within 60 ft takes damage, that creature gains Resistance to the damage and the witchwoven takes 3d6 Force.

summary: A twig-and-twine doll that scratches with a curse and takes part of a friend's wound onto itself.
